name: fl-design-system
description: Fission's own design system — scaffold a brand-new project on it, or install/update its branded shadcn components into an existing one. Pairs with the generic `design-system` plugin: once this has run, ds-button/ds-dialog/etc. detect this project as `shadcn:fission` automatically and route to it. Also holds Fission's token values and registry catalog, which `design-system`'s adapters read when mapping Fission's brand onto MUI/Chakra/AntD/plain CSS.
_schema_note: Verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference (checked 2026-10-09). The 'skills' array is intentionally omitted: it only adds to the default skills/ scan and fl-ds-setup already lives under skills/, so listing it was redundant. 'owners' and 'upstream' moved under 'metadata' — neither is a recognized top-level field and both would otherwise be silently stripped with a validate warning; 'metadata' is the documented place for free-form data Claude Code doesn't read.
